This hybrid strategy balances exploration and exploitation:

- Genetic algorithm explores a wide range of configurations through mutation and crossover
- Local optimization refines promising candidates to lower the minimum
- We maintain a population of multiple individuals during the search
- Symmetry is preserved by defining only half the function
